title: Validate sales stock-out draft warehouse and line shape before commitment
description: Stage 3 verified write-validation gap in the sales-to-inventory operational link, the same defect class repaired for sales orders (ERP-422/ERP-427) and already applied to the sibling purchase receipt by ERP-352. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockOutController.cs:140-169 Create authorizes the menu (:143) and the customer (:151), normalizes the optional sales-order link (:144-148), converts units (:152), recalculates totals (:153) and validates only the optional SalesOrderId link (:154) before saving (:166-167); :179+ Update does the same. src/ERP.Application/Services/StockOutAuthorizationRules.cs exposes only EnsureMenuAuthorizedAsync (:67), EnsureSourceMenuAuthorizedAsync (:109) and EnsureCustomerAuthorizedAsync (:136) and has no warehouse or product validator, unlike the sibling src/ERP.Application/Services/StockInAuthorizationRules.cs:153-166 EnsureAuthorizedAsync which calls EnsureWarehouseAvailableAsync (:286-294) to reject a missing or deleted or disabled warehouse; and src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockUnitConversion.cs:38-59 silently skips lines whose product is missing (:46) and never checks the quantity sign or the product status. A draft can therefore persist WarehouseId = 0 or a soft-deleted or disabled warehouse, a soft-deleted or disabled product, a zero, negative or EF-unrepresentable Quantity, and duplicate product lines; Approve (:247-300) rejects a negative quantity (:281-282) and src/ERP.Application/Services/InventoryService.cs:356-362 rejects a non-positive quantity and a missing product id only after the malformed draft is already stored, page-visible and submittable. Add a shared draft guard to StockOutAuthorizationRules and call it on create and update after unit conversion and before the write, keeping the existing live identity, menu and customer authority, server-owned document number and detail identity, row locks, serializable transactions, cumulative shipment capacity guard and StockMovements ledger unchanged. No new table, column, index or menu. Preserve supported empty draft headers if established; all explicit effective lines require valid positive bounded quantities and nonnegative representable prices/costs. Submit/approval requires nonempty valid lines. Validate calculated line and header amounts against real EF precision/overflow before numbering or writes, not merely each factor separately. Preserve supported repeated product lines and cumulative quantity semantics, do not introduce an arbitrary uniqueness rule. Preserve current business permissions and actor/customer scope; no new grants. Adapt all affected original fixtures with real enabled identities and existing menus/master rows, never remove business assertions or retain null-context/provider/test exceptions. Full original failure logs retained. Explicit test output/TRX/results directories must be .ai/logs/<task> only, never repository-root TestResults. SQL must use exactly (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets before access, never drop/reset. Safe Release restore/build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine isolated SQL validation; no whole-stage acceptance or production access. Related original source-selection, loading-cancellation and return-cancellation isolated SQL fixtures that call these controllers are explicitly authorized for genuine master/identity fixture adaptation only. Preserve all original inventory quantity, movement/cancellation, source ownership and concurrency assertions. Include relevant related SQL regressions before completion; do not weaken business validators, authorize production access or change transaction contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Create and update on /api/inventory/stock-outs reject, before any StockOut or StockOutDetail write and before consuming a document number, a non-positive WarehouseId, a warehouse that does not exist or is soft-deleted or disabled, a detail with a non-positive or EF-unrepresentable Quantity, a detail whose ProductId is missing or does not exist or is soft-deleted or disabled, using the existing controlled validation errors with zero persisted change; the unit conversion still runs first so package-unit lines are normalized to the product base unit before the checks.

Retain every existing stock-out boundary: live identity, account status, sales-out menu and customer scope are still resolved before any read or write, the optional SalesOrderId link still uses StockOutOrderFulfillmentRules, server-owned document number, status, timestamps and detail identity are unchanged, and approve, reverse, cancel and delete keep the existing row locks, serializable transactions, cumulative shipment quantity guard and StockMovements ledger, with no new table, column, index, menu, grant or permission.

Add genuine unit tests and isolated SQL controller tests covering create and update for a missing, zero, deleted and disabled warehouse, zero and negative quantity, unrepresentable quantity, missing, deleted and disabled product, repeated product lines with correct cumulative quantities, empty details and the permitted flow, asserting zero StockOut, StockOutDetail, StockMovement and document-number change on every rejection; existing StockOutControllerTests, StockOutOrderFulfillmentTests, StockOutSourceSelectionTests, StockOutWriteScopeRegressionTests and StockOutAuthorizationTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, run genuine SQL only on the isolated localdb NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database that is never dropped or reset, and claim no whole-stage acceptance from a build alone.

Preserve currently supported empty draft headers and repeated product lines; validate every explicitly supplied effective line, and require nonempty valid lines before submit or approval. Numeric validation includes calculated line/header representability and overflow after existing unit normalization. Rejected calls consume no number and change no document/detail/inventory/source rows.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockOutController.cs:140-169 Create validates only the menu (:143) and customer (:151) plus the optional SalesOrderId link (:154) before Db.StockOuts.Add and SaveChanges (:166-167), and :179+ Update repeats the same shape; src/ERP.Application/Services/StockOutAuthorizationRules.cs declares only EnsureMenuAuthorizedAsync (:67), EnsureSourceMenuAuthorizedAsync (:109) and EnsureCustomerAuthorizedAsync (:136) with no warehouse or product validator, while the sibling src/ERP.Application/Services/StockInAuthorizationRules.cs:153-166 EnsureAuthorizedAsync calls EnsureWarehouseAvailableAsync (:286-294); src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockUnitConversion.cs:38-59 skips lines with a missing product (:46) and never validates quantity or product status; Approve rejects only a negative quantity (:281-282) and src/ERP.Application/Services/InventoryService.cs:356-362 rejects a non-positive quantity and missing product id, i.e. only after the malformed draft is stored; an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task adding draft warehouse, product or line-shape validation to StockOutController.
